extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and editors (especially those working on biographies of living persons and sourcing/verifiability)
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluating or improving a Wikipedia biography of a living person for compliance with Biography of Living Persons (BLP) and general sourcing/verifiability policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article relies largely or entirely on a single source
rubrics_metrics.description: This biography of a living person relies largely or entirely on a single source.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please help by adding reliable sources. (Page shows the maintenance tag inviting editors to add more sources; examples of sources to find are listed: news, newspapers, books, scholar, JSTOR.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Contentious material about living persons must be removed if unsourced or poorly sourced
rubrics_metrics.description: Contentious material about living persons that is unsourced or poorly sourced must be removed immediately, especially if potentially libelous or harmful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remove such material from the article and its talk page immediately. The maintenance notice emphasizes urgency and potential legal/ethical harm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biography needs additional citations for verification
rubrics_metrics.description: This biography of a living person needs additional citations for verification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors are asked to add reliable sources to verify statements; the page includes multiple dated maintenance tags (e.g., May 2020, October 2022) indicating outstanding citation needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use reliable sources (recommended source types)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find sources: 'Carol Marin' – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The maintenance text explicitly suggests these types of reliable sources as appropriate for verifying content in the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unsourced statements are flagged with 'citation needed' and should be sourced
rubrics_metrics.description: Parts of the article include inline 'citation needed' markers for specific unsourced statements (e.g., career paragraphs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific claims tagged with 'citation needed' should be supported with citations or removed/rewritten per BLP/verifiability policy.
